# srallyc (Sega Rally Championship, Revision C; Model 2A-CRX): entry points
# the recompiler cannot find by itself. The code runs from work RAM
# 0x5a0000-0x5fffff (the boot copy of ROM 0x1000-0x60fff; recompile.py passes
# m2recomp --alias), so most addresses are there.
# Addresses only (our own analysis; rules.md rule 7). One hex address per line.
# scripts/seed_scan.py
